summary: Honor MP4 presentation order for independent layered HEVC access units
before: Owned independent layered HEVC AUs with ctts PTS 0,2,1,3 reach native POC-ordered SingleView without the common MP4 PTS reorder queue. Sequential playback first exposes interval (0,2,25), then refuses non-increasing timestamps. Both new tests fail; the ordered 0,1,2,3 companion passes its assertions before the reordered case fails.
after: Select the existing common bounded presentation/seek pipeline when a layered track has decreasing container PTS. The monotonic layer-selection route remains unchanged. Two focused and 26 related player tests pass: four exact oracle-matched frames at 25Hz/160ms, ten seeks per file matching sequential RGB/intervals, rewind and repeated EOF, layered HDR/IRAP/metadata navigation and mixed-description controls.
tests_run: cargo test --locked --offline --features player --test mp4_layered_seek_coverage --test hevc_layered_playback --test hevc_inband_layered_dispatch --test mixed_layered_descriptions --test mp4_zero_default_duration
independence: One common-player container-vs-codec ordering cause; ordered/reordered inputs, frames, seek positions and decoder-route reuse count once.
